activity.notes: The National Army Museum records Carton de Wiart's Victoria Cross action at La Boiselle on 2-3 July 1916 while serving as acting lieutenant-colonel commanding the 8th Battalion, Gloucestershire Regiment. ATLAS uses only this exact combat interval, not his lifespan or full military career.
